notes.custom-saas/deepseek-deepseek-v4-pro-cp: DeepSeek V4 Pro — strongest code generation, Forge.
notes.custom-saas/kimi-k2.6-saas: Kimi K2.6 — long-context (retired from Lens roster after visual merge; kept for reference).
notes.custom-saas/kimi-k3-saas: Kimi K3 — strong reasoning for analysis (Analyst).
notes.custom-saas/qwen3.7-plus: Qwen 3.7 plus — fastest model on gateway (736ms) AND plus-tier reasoning. Atlas (orchestrator) + Scout: routing/dispatch quality matters more than raw speed.
notes.custom-saas/minimax-m3-saas: MiniMax M3 (saas id) — fast M3 quality for prose (Writer).
selection_tips: Atlas (orchestrator): fast routing is enough — M2.7-highspeed.
Forge (implementer): needs strong code gen — deepseek-v4-pro-cp.
Lens (reviewer + visual): multimodal M3 — code review AND screenshot verification in one (Vis merged into Lens).
Scout (research): reads many sources fast — qwen3.7-plus.
